name: WHISK
statusNote: A little bakery. A shiny little trailer. Coming your way soon.
heroText: Something sweet, something buttery, something worth stopping for. Meet Whisk, Cindy’s little bakery on wheels.
aboutHeading:
A little flour.
A lot of Cindy.
aboutText: Whisk is a small bakery with a shiny little home: a polished silver trailer. Cindy is getting ready to open the service window and share what’s baking. We can’t wait to meet you there.
aboutNote: Cindy’s story is still being written. Come back soon for a proper hello.
hours: Opening hours will be announced with our first pop-up.
pickup: Pickup details will be shared when ordering opens. Please check the date, time, and location before paying.
cutoff: Order deadlines will be listed with each menu release.
refunds: Cancellation and refund details will be posted before we begin taking orders.
allergens: Ingredient and allergen details will be confirmed before ordering opens. If you have a food allergy, please contact Cindy before ordering. Dietary labels do not guarantee the absence of cross-contact.
